main.description: A record for a subject that Hypercerts records can describe, such as a zone or stratum. It carries the subject's identity, classification, and optional published spatial representations. Geometry itself lives in app.certified.location records, and grouping lives in org.hypercerts.collection records.

type.description: The coarse kind of subject this feature is, for example zone (an area a steward authors and manages) or stratum (an analytical unit derived from a model or methodology). This is not the feature's role or detailed classification — those are expressed through tags. Values beyond the known set are permitted.

description.description: Long-form description of the feature, as an inline string, a Leaflet document, or a reference to another record.

locations.description: Optional published spatial representations of this feature. Each referenced record must conform with app.certified.location. Multiple entries are alternative representations of the same subject at different precisions or encodings — for example an exact polygon and a coarser public representation for a sensitive site — never different places. Genuinely different places are either one MultiPolygon inside a single location record, or separate features. An empty or absent array is valid: the subject's geometry is unpublished or not applicable.

tags.description: References to org.hypercerts.tag records classifying this record. All listed tags apply simultaneously (logical AND); the array carries no ordering, weighting, negation, inheritance, or rule logic, and never will — any future expression logic must arrive as a new field and must never reinterpret this one.

sameAs.description: URIs of external identifiers that denote the same real-world subject, for example a cadastral parcel ID or a gazetteer entry. Entity identity only; vocabulary concordance belongs on org.hypercerts.tag.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.
